verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets users find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities and automate workflows from their AI assistant, so natural-language operation is possible through a first-party integration. However, the language understanding happens in an external assistant, and there is no documented native natural-language command interface inside Pipedrive. The 'manage deals with AI' claim is too vague to count as NL command support. Missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface, detail on the scope of supported commands and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
